title: 第3章 打了小的来老的
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
林尘从寒月阁出来的时候，天已经黑透了。

    他揣着凝气丹，往山下外门住处走，脚步比平时轻快不少。

    炼气六层了。

    照这个速度，筑基也就是十天半个月的事。

    回到外门杂役房，几个同屋的弟子还没睡，正围着桌子赌灵石。

    看见林尘推门进来，全都愣了一下。

    “林尘？你修为又涨了？”

    “炼气六层？昨天不是才四层吗？”

    “你他娘的到底吃了什么灵丹妙药？给我们也分点啊。”

    林尘把外衣往床头一扔，懒得解释。

    “修炼练的，你们信不信。”

    “信个鬼。修炼能一天涨两层，我把这桌子吃了。”

    几个弟子笑骂了几句，也没深究。

    外门弟子之间交情不深，各有各的门路，谁也不会真去刨根问底。

    第二天一早，林尘照常去演武场领任务。

    刚走到门口，就看见一群人围着布告栏议论什么。

    “刘威去找他堂哥了。”

    “刘威的堂哥？那不是内门核心弟子吗？”

    “对啊，筑基后期的那个刘峰。听说刘威昨天被林尘挡了一拳，回去就找刘峰告状了。”

    “这下林尘麻烦了。”

    林尘脚步一顿。

    刘峰，内门核心弟子，筑基后期。

    这他娘的打了小的来了老的？

    他没理会那些议论，领了任务就去后山砍柴。

    砍到一半，身后传来脚步声。

    不止一个人。

    林尘转过身，就看见刘威带着一个身材高壮的男子走了过来。

    那男子穿着一身内门核心弟子的青色锦袍，袖口绣着戒律堂的标识，面容冷峻，眼神阴沉。

    筑基后期，刘峰。

    “堂哥，就是他！”

    刘威指着林尘，语气里全是怨气。

    “这个废物前天还是炼气三层，现在就炼气六层了！他肯定偷吃了禁药！”

    刘峰没说话，走到林尘面前，上下打量了他一遍。

    那种眼神像是在看一件货物。

    “炼气六层。”

    刘峰的声音很平。

    “听说你几天升了六层。”

    “修炼快也犯法？”

    林尘扛着柴刀，一脸无所谓。

    “修炼快不犯法。”

    刘峰盯着他。

    “但几天升六层，谁信？”

    “信不信是你的事。”

    “敢这么跟我说话？”

    刘峰眼神一冷。

    “知不知道我是谁？”

    “内门核心弟子，刘峰。筑基后期，修炼八年，在核心弟子里排第三十七。还需要我继续背吗？”

    刘峰的脸色变了。

    不是因为林尘知道他的底细，而是因为林尘说这话的时候，那种满不在乎的语气。

    一个外门弟子，面对内门核心，不应该这么嚣张。

    除非他有底牌。

    “看来你是真不知道死字怎么写。”

    刘峰冷笑一声。

    “今天我就替戒律堂验一验，你到底是吃了什么药才突破这么快。”

    他抬手一抓，五指成爪，筑基后期的灵力凝聚在指尖，带起一阵尖锐的风声。

    “给我跪下！”
content_en:
When Lin Chen came out of Hanyue Pavilion, it was already dark.

    He carried the Qi Condensation Pill and walked towards his residence at the outer gate of the mountain, his steps much lighter than usual.

    It’s the sixth level of Qi refining.

    At this rate, foundation building would only take ten days and a half.

    Returning to the outer door miscellaneous room, several disciples in the same room were still awake and were gambling on spiritual stones around the table.

    When they saw Lin Chen push the door open and come in, everyone was stunned for a moment.

    "Lin Chen? Has your cultivation level increased again?"

    "Sixth level of Qi refining? Wasn't it only the fourth level yesterday?"

    "What the hell kind of magic elixir did you take? Share some with us."

    Lin Chen threw his coat on the bedside and didn't bother to explain.

    "You are practicing, believe it or not."

    "Believe it or not. Cultivation can increase you to two levels a day. I'll eat this table."

    Several disciples laughed and cursed a few times, but did not delve into it.

    The friendship between the outer sect disciples is not deep, each has its own path, and no one will really get to the bottom of it.

    Early the next morning, Lin Chen went to the martial arts arena to receive tasks as usual.

    As soon as I walked to the door, I saw a group of people discussing something around the bulletin board.

    "Liu Wei went to find his cousin."

    "Liu Wei's cousin? Isn't that the core disciple of the inner sect?"

    "Yes, the Liu Feng in the later stage of foundation building. I heard that Liu Wei was blocked by Lin Chen yesterday, so he went back to complain to Liu Feng."

    "Lin Chen is in trouble now."

    Lin Chen paused.

    Liu Feng, a core disciple of the inner sect, is in the late stage of foundation building.

    Damn, did you hit the younger one or the older one?

    He ignored those comments and went to the back mountain to chop wood after receiving the assignment.

    Halfway through the cut, footsteps came from behind.

    More than one person.

    Lin Chen turned around and saw Liu Wei walking over with a tall man.

    The man was wearing a blue brocade robe worn by a core disciple of the inner sect, with the logo of the Discipline Hall embroidered on the cuffs. He had a stern face and gloomy eyes.

    In the later stage of foundation building, Liu Feng.

    "Cousin, that's him!"

    Liu Wei pointed at Lin Chen, his tone full of resentment.

    "This loser was at the third level of Qi Refining the day before yesterday, and now he is at the sixth level of Qi Refining! He must have secretly taken forbidden drugs!"

    Liu Feng didn't say anything. He walked up to Lin Chen and looked him up and down.

    That kind of look is like looking at a piece of goods.

    "Sixth level of Qi refining."

    Liu Feng's voice was calm.

    "I heard that you rose to the sixth level in a few days."

    "Is it illegal to practice fast?"

    Lin Chen was carrying a hatchet with a nonchalant look on his face.

    “It’s not illegal to practice fast.”

    Liu Feng stared at him.

    "But who will believe that it will be upgraded to the sixth floor in a few days?"

    "It's your business to believe it or not."

    "How dare you talk to me like that?"

    Liu Feng's eyes turned cold.

    "Do you know who I am?"

    "Liu Feng, a core disciple of the inner sect. He has been practicing for eight years in the late stage of foundation building and ranks thirty-seventh among the core disciples. Do you still need me to continue to memorize it?"

    Liu Feng's expression changed.

    It wasn't because Lin Chen knew his true identity, but because of Lin Chen's nonchalant tone when he said this.

    An outer sect disciple should not be so arrogant when facing the core of the inner sect.

    Unless he has a trump card.

    "It seems you really don't know how to write the word death."

    Liu Feng sneered.

    "Today I will test it for the Discipline Hall. What kind of medicine did you take to break through so quickly?"

    He raised his hand and grabbed it, his five fingers forming claws. The spiritual energy from the late stage of foundation building was concentrated on his fingertips, causing a sharp sound of wind.

    "Kneel down!"
title_en: Chapter 3: Beat the young to make the old
